name: oblique-2
note: ONE test per card: 2 deg oblique steps, well INSIDE FineAngle=6 (the fine servo owns it). Diamond of radius 1.41 deg; N->E->S->W->N makes every step a 45-deg oblique of 2.0 deg, one per direction, all from the same energy state. Compare against oblique-6 / oblique-12, and each direction against its mirror. AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition.
